text: [warm] Hi, and welcome to Fabric! [excited] In the next two minutes, I'll show you how Fabric turns everyday conversations about your work... into clear, living process maps, and practical ways to improve them.

This is your workspace. On the left is the Process Tree: your organization, laid out as functions, departments, and the processes inside them. Click to expand any branch... [curious] or press Control K to jump straight to a process by name.

Every process has its own page, [confident] and this is where it all starts. Hit Start AI interview, and Fabric's voice agent will talk you through how the work really gets done: the steps, the tools, the handoffs. [casual] Prefer to go solo? Record a voice note, or upload a recording you already have.
Every interview lands in the Contributions tab, with the audio, an AI summary, and a full transcript you can read and replay.

[impressed] Now here's where it gets interesting. Fabric reads across every contribution and writes a single overview of the process: the key facts up top, then the full story. [thoughtful] Further down, it shows where people agree, where their accounts differ... and which sources back up each point. The more people you interview, the sharper the picture gets.

Open Process Flow to see it all as a map: every step, decision, and handoff, built from what people actually said. Bottlenecks are flagged right on the steps, so you can spot the friction at a glance.
Insights starts with key findings: the places worth a closer look. Then it rolls everything up into the numbers: steps, handoffs, tools, decisions, and bottlenecks, each traced back to the evidence.

[excited] And finally, Recommendations: what to change, and why. Fabric suggests practical fixes, from a clear handover rule to a new workflow, each ranked by value and effort, and backed by what people actually said. [confident] Every recommendation comes with a small pilot to try... and a change plan you can copy and share with your team.
[warm] So that's Fabric. Pick a process you know well, hit Start AI interview, and just talk. [cheerful] We'll take care of the rest!
